name: Elder Voice
body:
You may select an aberration companion if you meet certain prerequisites.

Prerequisites: Handle Animal 5 ranks, Knowledge (dungeoneering) 5 ranks, animal companion or combination of animal companions with effective druid level 7.

Benefit(s): You can select a creature from the list of aberration companions (see New Animal Companions) to serve as your animal companion. You acquire and advance this companion in the same way as an animal companion detailed in the class feature that grants you access to your animal companion. You can dismiss the creature, as dictated by your class feature.

You must meet additional prerequisites to select a companion with an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, a described in each creature’s entry.
